whenToUse: Lists of content with images, such as articles, products, or places.
People scan many at a glance and choose.
A card has one small action inside, such as save.
whenNotToUse: Items are compared in detail (use a table).
There's only a title and no image (use a list).
A card holds many links and buttons.

alternatives.name: Masonry Grid
alternatives.reason: Packing cards of different heights tightly.

accessibility: The only link is the title, and a pseudo-element stretches it over the whole card, so pressing anywhere opens it.
The save button sits above the link and works on its own, announcing its state with aria-pressed.
The image area is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
Keyboard focus shows as an outline around the whole card.
